title: March or light jog
tips: March easily; lift one knee, then the other.
Keep it gentle and give yourself space.
alt: Animated diagram of march or light jog at an easy pace.

title: Lateral steps
tips: Stay comfortably low and step side to side.
Keep feet apart; move at an easy pace.
alt: Animated diagram of lateral steps at an easy pace.

title: Ankle rocks
tips: Keep the heel down and gently rock the knee forward.
Use a small, comfortable range; never force it.
alt: Animated diagram of ankle rocks at an easy pace.

title: Gentle squats
tips: Bend hips and knees a little, then stand tall.
Keep feet planted and use a comfortable depth.
alt: Animated diagram of gentle squats at an easy pace.

title: Easy dribble
tips: Use light fingertip control; keep the ball nearby.
Practice each hand slowly, with eyes up when comfortable.
alt: Animated diagram of easy dribble at an easy pace.

title: Form shooting
tips: Start close with balanced feet and the elbow comfortably under the ball.
Keep the guide hand light and quiet.
Release smoothly and hold your follow-through; stay closer if needed.
alt: Side-view shooting diagram: set the ball with a light guide hand, release smoothly, then hold the follow-through.

title: Crossover → layup
tips: Bend hips and knees into a low, stable stance; keep eyes up.
Use a quick, low bounce below the knees, then plant and push into the open lane.
Finish with the right hand off the left foot; use a soft touch high on the square.
alt: Back-view diagram of a right-side crossover into a layup. Start left hand; ball path L → R. Finish RIGHT · off LEFT foot.

title: Crossover → layup

title: Double crossover → layup
tips: Sell the first change; stay low for a quick second crossover.
After the ball comes back, push off and accelerate into the open lane.
Finish with the right hand off the left foot; use a soft touch high on the square.
alt: Back-view diagram of a right-side double crossover into a layup. Start right hand; ball path R → L → R. Finish RIGHT · off LEFT foot.

title: In-and-out → layup
tips: Fake inward, then bring it out in the SAME hand; no carrying or palming.
Sell the fake with your shoulder and eyes, then push off into the open lane.
Finish with the right hand off the left foot; use a soft touch high on the square.
alt: Back-view diagram of a right-side in-and-out into a layup. Start right hand; ball path R → inward → R. Finish RIGHT · off LEFT foot.

title: Crossover → pull-up
tips: Bend hips and knees into a low, stable stance; keep eyes up.
Use a quick, low bounce below the knees, then plant and push into the open lane.
Create space, gather with both hands, stop balanced, and rise straight with your normal shooting and guide hand.
